summary_en: 500,000 shares (5.5% of outstanding), ¥500M upper limit, open-market purchase June 8, 2026 – January 31, 2027. Concurrent cancellation of 1,010,000 treasury shares effective June 8, 2026. Rationale: enhance capital efficiency and ROE/PBR targets toward FY2028 mid-term strategy.
title_en: Notice of Resolution to Acquire Own Shares and Cancellation of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: Miraial's board resolved on June 1, 2026 to acquire up to 500,000 shares (5.5% of outstanding shares) with a ¥500 million upper budget via open-market purchase between June 8, 2026 and January 31, 2027. The company simultaneously resolved to cancel 1,010,000 treasury shares held as of that date, effective June 8, 2026. The rationale centers on improving capital efficiency and shareholder returns in pursuit of ROE and PBR enhancement targets embedded in the FY2028 (January 2029) five-year mid-term growth strategy announced two years prior. The company aims to achieve sustainable PBR above 1.0x and maximize long-term enterprise value through balanced capital allocation and balance-sheet optimization while pursuing continued business growth.
